blocker: B1 - CUSUM compact-cover admission, original cells 319-323 at m=5

conditions.check: count record files and their cell_index set
conditions.statement: the record universe is exactly the 326 cells 0..325, no more, no fewer

conditions.check: count obligation slots per record; m-key set equality
conditions.statement: the obligation universe is exactly 1304 = 326 cells x 4 m-values {1,2,3,5}

conditions.check: resolve export_manifest_sha256, composite_audit_sha256, k4_attestation_sha256, both halves' ledger_state/integrity_audit/authorization/countersignature hashes
conditions.statement: every source hash named by the export manifest and the composite audit resolves

conditions.check: recompute sha256 per record file and compare to the manifest map
conditions.statement: every record's scientific hash verifies against the export manifest entry

conditions.check: producer_identity_hash + production_checkpoint_sha256 present and equal to the frozen values for the half that owns the cell
conditions.statement: the producer lineage is explicitly identified for every admitted cell

conditions.check: record hashes equal the hashes recorded by the composite audit taken at closure; the audit's own digest is unchanged
conditions.statement: no post-result editing of scientific values

conditions.check: COMPOSITE_AUDIT.result_agnostic is true AND obligation_statuses_read is false AND K4 attestation k4_values_evaluated is false
conditions.statement: the composite construction is result-agnostic by its own declaration

conditions.check: each half carries an authorization AND a countersignature issued before its own campaign, and the campaign predates the K1R preregistration freeze
conditions.statement: temporal provenance suffices for use as an ADDITIVE successor source

conditions.check: no per-cell, per-m or per-half selection is representable in this contract
conditions.statement: admission is total: the whole 326-cell composite or nothing

conditions.check: HOST_AT_CLOSURE library/package identities resolve, and the runtime that produced each half matches the authorization countersigned for that half
conditions.statement: no host/runtime identity inconsistency that invalidates scientific use

decision_inputs_forbidden: anything that reveals whether a cell passes
disclosed_prior_observation: During the read-only residual-blocker reconstruction that preceded this preregistration, the Aux5 record statuses were observed (326/326 cells, 1304/1304 obligations PASS, m=5 utilisation 0.583-0.733 on cells 319-323). This is disclosed so no reviewer is misled about what was known. It creates no selection freedom: admission is total under A9, the admission conditions read no scientific value, and the Aux5 kill gate halts K1R if any admitted obligation is not PASS.
historical_mechanism: B_cover curvature-budget exhaustion under the old cover width: curvature = M_R2 * w^2 / 8 crossed the frozen 1/20 cap at m=5. NOT an observed target-bound violation: the enclosures were 0.0991-0.1636 against target 2.

AUX5_COMPOSITE_ADMISSION.effect: the 326-cell composite is admitted INDIVISIBLY as the B1 source

PREREGISTERED_RECOMPUTE_FALLBACK.host: the qualified CUSUM runtime consistent with the selected producer lineage; never the Mac

PREREGISTERED_RECOMPUTE_FALLBACK.taken_when: any condition A1..A10 FAILS (then zero Aux5 records are admitted)
